content.text: I changed the early return in `src/lexer.rs` to check `input.trim().is_empty()`. The lexer still receives the original input, so `"  "` keeps both quoted spaces. All three regression cases pass.

content.text:
**All 18 tests pass.** Whitespace-only input now produces an empty token list. Quoted spaces still produce a word token.

| Input | Tokens |
| --- | --- |
| Three unquoted spaces | `[]` |
| Two spaces inside quotes | `[Word("  ")]` |

The change is confined to the empty-input guard in `src/lexer.rs`.
